# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/consistentdepth
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/consistent_depth

## File: facebookresearch_consistentdepth/monodepth/monodepth2/layers.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to convert sigmoid disparity output into depth predictions using min and max depth bounds', 'create a 4x4 transformation matrix from axisangle rotation and translation vectors with optional inversion', 'test the compute_depth_errors function to calculate abs_rel, rmse, and accuracy metrics between ground truth and predicted depths', 'review the SSIM class to compute structural similarity loss between pairs of images using pooled statistics', 'refactor the BackprojectDepth class to transform a depth image into a 3D point cloud using camera intrinsics']
```

Usage

```
{'build_disp_to_depth': 'build a python module to convert sigmoid disparity output into depth predictions using min and max depth bounds', 'create_transformation_from_parameters': 'create a 4x4 transformation matrix from axisangle rotation and translation vectors with optional inversion', 'test_compute_depth_errors': 'test the compute_depth_errors function to calculate abs_rel, rmse, and accuracy metrics between ground truth and predicted depths', 'review_SSIM': 'review the SSIM class to compute structural similarity loss between pairs of images using pooled statistics', 'refactor_BackprojectDepth': 'refactor the BackprojectDepth class to transform a depth image into a 3D point cloud using camera intrinsics'}
```
name: facebookresearch_consistentdepth/monodepth/monodepth2/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_consistentdepth/monodep.build_disp_to_depth: build a python module to convert sigmoid disparity output into depth predictions using min and max depth bounds
facebookresearch_consistentdepth/monodep.create_transformation_from_parameters: create a 4x4 transformation matrix from axisangle rotation and translation vectors with optional inversion
facebookresearch_consistentdepth/monodep.test_compute_depth_errors: test the compute_depth_errors function to calculate abs_rel, rmse, and accuracy metrics between ground truth and predicted depths
facebookresearch_consistentdepth/monodep.review_SSIM: review the SSIM class to compute structural similarity loss between pairs of images using pooled statistics
facebookresearch_consistentdepth/monodep.refactor_BackprojectDepth: refactor the BackprojectDepth class to transform a depth image into a 3D point cloud using camera intrinsics
